page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.3xlarge is an x86_64 virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance features 48.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be provisioned via external network-attached block storage. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or graphics processing units.

The dedicated CPU allocation and 3.4 GHz clock speed ensure stable compute performance for applications requiring consistent processing power. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for general-purpose workloads, application servers, web serving, and mid-tier databases that do not require local NVMe storage.
